json.evidence: Photos 1-3 show one utility meter and one large gray service panel opened, with no second independent service-main panel evident. Photos 4-14 show added Base/battery equipment, batteries, conduit, and small disconnect/control boxes to the right of the original service equipment. The added white Base box and small boxes appear as battery/transfer/disconnect equipment connected near the existing service panel, not as separate independent service mains. No photo shows two or more panels each with clearly visible independent main breakers/disconnects and evidence that each functions as an independent service main.
json.notes: Multiple mains are not proven by the photos; visible extra boxes appear related to the battery installation rather than separate utility service mains.
